title: Doctor --fix refuses under an inherited verification context, and read-only doctor still reports
description: doctor --fix refuses under an inherited verification context, and read-only doctor still reports
acceptance_criteria: doctor --fix, with or without --dry-run or --close-late, refuses under an inherited SPECSYNC_VERIFICATION_CONTEXT with the one recursion diagnostic and exit 1; doctor without --fix gives the same output and exit status with the marker as without it (red then green)
